The *Catutthapīṭhavimānavatthu* ("Fourth Throne Mansion", Vv 4) is a short poetic text situated within the *Vimānavatthu* section of the Pali canon. In the narrative, the Arahant Mahāmoggallāna encounters a *deva* and inquires about the specific meritorious actions that led to his rebirth in heaven and his possession of a divine throne composed of beryl gemstones.
